title: Climate-related hazards (e.g. flooding & sea level rise currently)
description: A meta-collection of U.S. national climate- and flood-hazard geospatial layers, combining NOAA Office for Coastal Management sea level rise inundation projections (5 ft scenario) and the FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer (NFHL) flood zones, distributed in cloud-native formats (GeoParquet, PMTiles, H3 hex) for hazard mapping and spatial analysis. A third member covering mid-century habitat climate exposure is documented but excluded from this mirror pending license confirmation.

## README.md
# Climate & Flood Hazard Layers (`public-hazard`)

National climate- and flood-hazard datasets for the United States, processed to
cloud-native formats (GeoParquet, PMTiles, H3 hex, COG) and hosted on NRP S3.

This is a **meta-collection**: each member below is an independent dataset with its
own source, license, and STAC sub-collection (and its own `README.md`). The
bucket-level license is therefore `various` — **see each member for its actual
license.**

## Members

| Dataset | Source | License | Formats |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`sea-level-rise`](https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hazard/sea-level-rise/stac-collection.json) | NOAA Office for Coastal Management — Sea Level Rise inundation (national, 5 ft scenario) | **public-domain** (U.S. Government work) | GeoParquet, PMTiles, H3 hex |
| [`flood-hazard`](https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hazard/flood-hazard/stac-collection.json) | FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer (NFHL) — flood hazard zones (national) | **public-domain** (U.S. Government work) | GeoParquet, PMTiles, H3 hex |
| [`mid-century-habitat-climate-exposure`](https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hazard/mid-century-habitat-climate-exposure/stac-collection.json) | Thorne et al. (2016), CDFW-commissioned (SWAP 2015) | **other** — redistribution terms not published with the source and require confirmation | COG, H3 hex |

> **Redistribution note.** `sea-level-rise` and `flood-hazard` are U.S. federal works
> (public domain). `mid-century-habitat-climate-exposure` ships **no explicit license**;
> its terms are unconfirmed, so it is **excluded** from the source.coop mirror of this
> bucket until CDFW/Thorne terms are confirmed. Do not assert a license for it.

## STAC

Catalog entry: <https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hazard/stac-collection.json>

## Usage

### MapLibre GL JS (PMTiles)

The `source-layer` is the last path segment of the dataset name — `flood-hazard` for
the FEMA layer, `sea-level-rise` for the NOAA layer.

```js
// requires the pmtiles protocol: https://github.com/protomaps/PMTiles
const protocol = new pmtiles.Protocol();
maplibregl.addProtocol("pmtiles", protocol.tile);

map.addSource("flood-hazard", {
  type: "vector",
  url: "pmtiles://https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hazard/flood-hazard.pmtiles",
});
map.addLayer({
  id: "flood-hazard-fill",
  type: "fill",
  source: "flood-hazard",
  "source-layer": "flood-hazard",   // = last segment of the dataset name
  paint: { "fill-color": "#3182bd", "fill-opacity": 0.4 },
});
```

### DuckDB (GeoParquet)

```sql
INSTALL spatial; LOAD spatial;
INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;

-- NOAA sea-level-rise inundation (national, 5 ft)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hazard/sea-level-rise.parquet');

-- FEMA flood hazard zones
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hazard/flood-hazard.parquet');
```

### H3 hex (spatial joins / aggregation)

```sql
SELECT h8, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hazard/sea-level-rise/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet')
GROUP BY h8;
```

For per-feature attributes that are repeated across the hex cells a feature covers,
dedup on the feature id before summing; for area, derive it from the H3 footprint (see
the catalog h3-guide) rather than summing a per-feature area column.
